scripts.coverage:report: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python coverage/curated/check_serialization.py && .venv/bin/python coverage/curated/report.py && .venv/bin/python coverage/paper/check_figures.py; else python3 coverage/curated/check_serialization.py && python3 coverage/curated/report.py && python3 coverage/paper/check_figures.py; fi
scripts.validate:shacl: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python tests/validate_shacl.py; else python3 tests/validate_shacl.py; fi
scripts.validate: npm run validate:fast && { npm run --silent validate:gate || { npm run validate:heavy && npm run validate:stamp; }; }
scripts.ocg:build: npm run ontology:bundle && ocg build && node scripts/insert-class-hierarchy.mjs site
scripts.validation:build: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/build-shacl-profiles.py; else python3 scripts/build-shacl-profiles.py; fi
scripts.versions:build: npm run validation:build && npm run examples:build && npm run ontology:bundle
scripts.examples:build: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/vcf_examples.py --write; else python3 scripts/vcf_examples.py --write; fi
scripts.validate:examples: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python tests/check_examples.py; else python3 tests/check_examples.py; fi
scripts.validate:regressions: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -W "ignore:'count' is passed as positional argument:DeprecationWarning:rdflib.plugins.sparql.operators" -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'; else python3 -W "ignore:'count' is passed as positional argument:DeprecationWarning:rdflib.plugins.sparql.operators" -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'; fi
scripts.validate:gate: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/validation-gate.py --check; else python3 scripts/validation-gate.py --check; fi
scripts.validate:gate:status: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/validation-gate.py --status; else python3 scripts/validation-gate.py --status; fi
scripts.validate:stamp: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/validation-gate.py --update; else python3 scripts/validation-gate.py --update; fi
scripts.validate:fast: npm run ontology:bundle && npm run validate:rdf && npm run coverage:report && npm run validate:examples && node coverage/paper/verify.mjs
scripts.validate:heavy: npm run validate:shacl && npm run validate:regressions
scripts.validate:force: npm run validate:fast && npm run validate:heavy && npm run validate:stamp
scripts.validate:serialization: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python coverage/curated/check_serialization.py; else python3 coverage/curated/check_serialization.py; fi
scripts.methodological:build: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python coverage/methodological/workflow.py build; else python3 coverage/methodological/workflow.py build; fi
scripts.methodological:check: sh -c 'if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python "$@"; else exec python3 "$@"; fi' -- coverage/methodological/workflow.py check
scripts.methodological:fetch: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python coverage/methodological/workflow.py fetch; else python3 coverage/methodological/workflow.py fetch; fi
scripts.methodological:test: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s coverage/methodological -p 'test_*.py'; else python3 -m unittest discover -s coverage/methodological -p 'test_*.py'; fi
scripts.methodological:review-probes: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python coverage/methodological/review_probes.py --check && .venv/bin/python coverage/methodological/review_profile_probes.py --check; else python3 coverage/methodological/review_probes.py --check && python3 coverage/methodological/review_profile_probes.py --check; fi
scripts.methodological:audit: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python coverage/methodological/workflow.py build --audit; else python3 coverage/methodological/workflow.py build --audit; fi
scripts.clean: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python scripts/clean.py; else python3 scripts/clean.py; fi
